sentences.en: Scotland did, unfortunately, just officially get kicked out of the World Cup this past weekend, but they clearly left an impression.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，苏格兰队在上周末刚刚正式被淘汰出世界杯，但他们显然留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: I mean, it was so pronounced, this love story between these Scottish fans and the Bostonians
sentences.zh: 我是说，这种苏格兰球迷与波士顿当地人之间的爱恋故事是如此鲜明，

sentences.en: that received them, that I think the Boston Globe literally dedicated a full page in the newspaper just thanking them for visiting.
sentences.zh: 甚至让《波士顿环球报》字面意义上在头版专门整版发文，感谢他们的到访。

sentences.en: They did indeed.
sentences.zh: 的确如此。

sentences.en: And now the Scots have a tradition for this.
sentences.zh: 现在苏格兰人在这方面也有了传统。

sentences.en: The way the fan culture works is be loud, be fun, drink all of the beer, but leave the people happy you were there.
sentences.zh: 这种球迷文化的运作方式就是：大声喊，尽情玩，喝光所有的啤酒，但离开时要让当地人因为你们的到来而感到高兴。

sentences.en: This was a culture that was created almost as an opposition to the hooliganism that was around English football and English fans in the 80s and 90s.
sentences.zh: 这种文化几乎是作为对上世纪80和90年代英国足球及英国球迷流氓行为的对立面而产生的。

sentences.en: I had no idea.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道。

sentences.en: That's so interesting.
sentences.zh: 太有趣了。

sentences.en: And it's not just the Scots.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是苏格兰人。

sentences.en: You can't manufacture some of these meetings.
sentences.zh: 其中有些相遇是无法刻意制造的。

sentences.en: They are chance meetings.
sentences.zh: 它们都是机缘巧合的相遇。

sentences.en: And we're seeing this in a way that perhaps we were not expecting because of the sensation or the feeling around the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们以一种或许意想不到的方式看到了这一点，因为美国上下弥漫着某种狂热或情愫。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so these international fans, they're being exposed to parts of America that they may never have seen otherwise.
sentences.zh: 所以这些国际球迷得以接触到他们平时可能永远见不到的美国部分。

sentences.en: And for Americans, you do see people trying to show their most open selves.
sentences.zh: 而对美国人来说，你确实能看到人们在努力展现出最开放的自我。

sentences.en: I think there's also the inquisitiveness.
sentences.zh: 我觉得其中也包含着一种好奇心。

sentences.en: People want to know about each other.
sentences.zh: 人们想要了解彼此。

sentences.en: And there's a pride as well.
sentences.zh: 其中也有一种自豪感。

sentences.en: Say, look, this is our town.
sentences.zh: 仿佛在说，看，这是我们的城镇。

sentences.en: This is who we are.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们。

sentences.en: And we want to show our best face.
sentences.zh: 我们要展现出最好的一面。

sentences.en: It also feels significant that this is happening at the same time that the United States celebrates its 250th anniversary.
sentences.zh: 这也显得意义重大，因为这正值美国庆祝建国250周年之际。

sentences.en: And some of those official celebrations have become very tied to President Trump, and they've become contentious in some cases for that reason.
sentences.zh: 其中一些官方庆典与特朗普总统紧密相连，也正因如此，在某些情况下它们引发了争议。

sentences.en: And then at the same time, you have this other celebration that's happening all across the country that also feels like it's saying something important about the United States
sentences.zh: 与此同时，全国各地还在举行另一场庆祝活动，这让人感觉同样在诉说着关于美国的重要事情，

sentences.en: and its identity.
sentences.zh: 以及它的身份认同。

sentences.en: Yeah, it tells us that this country is a patchwork of people, and it was built on everybody.
sentences.zh: 是的，它告诉我们这个国家是由形形色色的人交织而成的，并且是建立在每个人之上的。

sentences.en: This is an immigrant nation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个移民国家。

sentences.en: The World Cup has shown it to be so.
sentences.zh: 世界杯已经证明了这一点。

sentences.en: Not only are the fans coming from overseas to support their teams, the entire diaspora of these teams is also behind them.
sentences.zh: 不仅海外球迷远道而来支持他们的球队，这些球队庞大的海外侨民群体也在支持着他们。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I met a guy who was Jordanian.
sentences.zh: 我遇到过一个约旦人。

sentences.en: And what's your name, sir?
sentences.zh: 请问尊姓大名，先生？

sentences.en: My name is Farouk Orfred.
sentences.zh: 我叫法鲁克·奥尔弗雷德。

sentences.en: This man called Farouk.
sentences.zh: 这个人叫法鲁克。

sentences.en: I moved to the state 46 years ago.
sentences.zh: 我46年前搬到了这个州。

sentences.en: 46 years ago?
sentences.zh: 46年前？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's a split love.
sentences.zh: 这是一份分裂的爱。

sentences.en: I love America more than anything.
sentences.zh: 我爱美国胜过一切。

sentences.en: And he just could not tell me how much he loved America.
sentences.zh: 他简直无法向我表达他有多么热爱美国。

sentences.en: It's the one that gave me the opportunity.
sentences.zh: 是这里给了我机遇。

sentences.en: It gave me everything.
sentences.zh: 它给了我一切。

sentences.en: My kids, I have three boys and a girl, they're all successful.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们，我有三个男孩和一个女孩，他们都很成功。

sentences.en: He was beaming about what America gave to him.
sentences.zh: 当谈到美国给予他的一切时，他满面春风。

sentences.en: But Jordan, it's my love.
sentences.zh: 但约旦，那是我的挚爱。

sentences.en: But he also said, I love Jordan.
sentences.zh: 但他也说过，我爱约旦。

sentences.en: How do you feel?
sentences.zh: 你现在感觉如何？

sentences.en: Oh my God, this is the proudest moment of my life.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，这是我一生中最骄傲的时刻。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: For a small nation of ours.
sentences.zh: 对于我们这样一个小国家来说。

sentences.en: You cannot believe how proud we are.
sentences.zh: 你无法想象我们有多么骄傲。

sentences.en: I am so proud that my country has made the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 我为我的国家打进世界杯感到无比骄傲。

sentences.en: I came to the first game, and I'm in the second game, then I'm going to go watch.
sentences.zh: 我来看了第一场比赛，现在又来看第二场，接下来我还要去观看……

sentences.en: He was off to Dallas next to see them against Lionel Messi.
sentences.zh: 他接下来要赶往达拉斯，观看他们对阵莱昂内尔·梅西的比赛。

sentences.en: Every day of the week, God bless America.
sentences.zh: 无论何时，上帝保佑美国。

sentences.en: God bless everything about this place.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑这里的一切。

sentences.en: And God bless my nation, Jordan.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑我的国家，约旦。

sentences.en: Thank you, Farouk.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，法鲁克。

sentences.en: So you can have that duality.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以拥有这种双重性。

sentences.en: It's also what it's shown.
sentences.zh: 这也是所展现出来的东西。

sentences.en: You can be two things.
sentences.zh: 你可以兼具两面。

sentences.en: You don't have to lash yourself to one flag or to the mast of one idea.
sentences.zh: 你不需要把自己绑在一面旗帜或某种单一观念的桅杆上。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: And in many ways, this is kind of the Diaspora World Cup.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这可以说是“海外侨民世界杯”。

sentences.en: Off the field and on the field, the word diaspora has been said over and over about this World Cup.
sentences.zh: 无论是在场外还是场上，“海外侨民”这个词在这届世界杯期间被反复提及。

sentences.en: But with that comes a degree of complexity.
sentences.zh: 但随之而来的也是某种程度的复杂性。

sentences.en: It is not a seamless thing.
sentences.zh: 这不是一件天衣无缝的事情。

sentences.en: This can sometimes be difficult.
sentences.zh: 这有时会很艰难。

sentences.en: Just talk about that side of things.
sentences.zh: 来谈谈这方面的情况吧。

sentences.en: What exactly you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你具体是什么意思？

sentences.en: The most obvious case has to be that of Iran.
sentences.zh: 最明显的例子肯定非伊朗莫属。

sentences.en: This is a team I've been following now for months since the start of the war.
sentences.zh: 这是自战争爆发以来，我跟进了几个月的球队。

sentences.en: This team has faced hardships unlike any other.
sentences.zh: 这支球队面临着前所未有的艰难险阻。

sentences.en: This is the first time a team participating at the World Cup has been in conflict, military conflict, with a host nation.
sentences.zh: 这是世界杯参赛球队历史上首次与主办国陷入军事冲突。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That has struck us here, too.
sentences.zh: 这在咱们这里也引发了触动。

sentences.en: I mean, the complications around the Iran team has been this major story of the World Cup for many reasons, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，围绕伊朗队的种种复杂情况由于种种原因成为了本届世界杯的一大新闻焦点，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the fans have had their own kind of hardships because of the feeling towards the government in Iran, the love of country in that context, and the love of team.
sentences.zh: 由于对伊朗政府的看法、在该语境下对国家的爱以及对球队的热爱，球迷们也经历了他们自己的艰难。

sentences.en: Do we support this team?
sentences.zh: 我们该支持这支球队吗？

sentences.en: Who does this team represent?
sentences.zh: 这支球队代表着谁？

sentences.en: And it has split the Iranian community somewhat.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上让伊朗社群产生了分裂。

sentences.en: I think most Iranians remain firmly supportive of the team on the field.
sentences.zh: 我认为大多数伊朗人仍然坚定地支持场上的这支球队。

sentences.en: But I've spoken to so many people who are trying to find ways to support the team, but also, in a way, protest or find a way of opposing the government back home.
sentences.zh: 但我交谈过很多人，他们一方面在寻找支持球队的方法，但另一方面也在寻找抗议或反对国内政府的途径。

sentences.en: You're saying this really big Iranian community in the United States is itself in conflict over how to relate to their own team, right?
sentences.zh: 你是说美国这个庞大的伊朗社群自身，在如何看待他们自己的球队这一点上也存在冲突，对吧？

sentences.en: Because they have such a conflicted relationship to their government.
sentences.zh: 因为他们与政府的关系是如此充满矛盾。

sentences.en: And the idea of how to support them is presenting all of these conundrums for these people.
sentences.zh: 以及如何支持他们的想法，给这些人带来了所有的这些难题。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: On the most extreme edge of this are people who simply will not support the team and say this is a propaganda tool of the government in Tehran.
sentences.zh: 在最极端的边缘，有些人干脆不予支持，并称这支球队是德黑兰政府的宣传工具。

sentences.en: This is not the Iranian team.
sentences.zh: 这不是真正的伊朗队。

sentences.en: But it's the majority in the middle.
sentences.zh: 但中间的大多数人才是主体。

sentences.en: They're the ones, I think, that are finding it the hardest because they do love this team.
sentences.zh: 我觉得正是他们觉得最难办，因为他们确实热爱这支球队。

sentences.en: They do love their country as well.
sentences.zh: 他们同样也深爱着自己的国家。

sentences.en: So how do you support them?
sentences.zh: 所以你该如何支持他们呢？

sentences.en: So we're almost seeing kind of the internal divisions of the Iranian opposition, Iranian politics writ large, around the outskirts of a World Cup stadium in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们几乎在洛杉矶的世界杯球场周边，看到了伊朗反对派、乃至广义伊朗政治的内部裂痕。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You're seeing this internal struggle of this diaspora play out live in front of us, in the stadiums, outside them,
sentences.zh: 你看到这个海外社群的内部斗争在我们面前实时上演，在球场内，也在球场外，

sentences.en: this internal debate inside of a community over how to relate to their team.
sentences.zh: 这是社群内部关于如何与自己的球队建立联系的一场辩论。

sentences.en: It's all there in public.
sentences.zh: 这一切都展现在公众面前。

sentences.en: It's all there in public and it's all in the face of those players.
sentences.zh: 这一切都展现在公众面前，也全摆在那些球员们的脸上。

sentences.en: So when the Iranian national anthem plays, you hear widespread booing, jeering across the stadium.
sentences.zh: 所以当伊朗国歌奏响时，你会听到球场内此起彼伏的嘘声和嘲笑声。

sentences.en: But when the team then takes to the field, it's like a home game.
sentences.zh: 但当球队随后踏上球场时，感觉就像是在打主场比赛。

sentences.en: What we are seeing in real time is a mashup of nationalism, of identity, of patriotism,
sentences.zh: 我们实时所看到的，是民族主义、身份认同、爱国主义的大杂烩，

sentences.en: of a sense of people trying to work out who they are, what they want, and what their future holds all around this international soccer tournament.
sentences.zh: 是人们围绕着这场国际足球赛事，试图弄清楚自己是谁、想要什么以及未来走向何方的种种心路历程。

sentences.en: Well, Tarek, thank you so much for being here.
sentences.zh: 好的，塔里克，非常感谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: Nice to be with you again.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能再次与你相聚。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重新构想者》，这是一个专注设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶时代的夜总会打碟时，你每晚都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去上班，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，摆满了50年前精美绝伦的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platform.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重新构想者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏板块的纵横连线（Connections）谜题，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天负责制作拼字蜜蜂（Spelling Bee）和字母宝箱（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色听觉”的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚刚听到的人这样的一群人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games，今天就开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: As we said before the break, the team in arguably the most complicated place in this World Cup is Iran.
sentences.zh: 正如我们在中场休息前所说，在这届世界杯上处境可以说是最复杂的球队就是伊朗队。

sentences.en: The team is playing in a host country that's in open conflict with theirs.
sentences.zh: 这支球队正在一个与他们处于公开交战状态的主办国参加比赛。

sentences.en: And now the whole world's watching as this fragile ceasefire gets tested again and again.
sentences.zh: 现在全世界都在注视着这个脆弱的停火协议一次又一次经受考验。

sentences.en: One of our show's producers, Anna Foley, spent time with a couple of lifelong fans of the Iranian team, just hours before Iran played their first game.
sentences.zh: 我们节目的制作人之一安娜·弗利，在伊朗队踢第一场比赛的几小时前，采访了几位伊朗队的铁杆球迷。

sentences.en: They talked about what all this is like this year, and the complex business of sorting out national pride and fandom in the middle of war.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了今年这一切的感受，以及在战争中理清民族自豪感与球迷热情的复杂事务。

sentences.en: Is there anything you miss from Iran?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么你是从伊朗怀念的？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然有。

sentences.en: This is Farhad.
sentences.zh: 这是法哈德。

sentences.en: Tell me something.
sentences.zh: 告诉我一些吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: People.
sentences.zh: 人。

sentences.en: The smell of land.
sentences.zh: 土地的气息。

sentences.en: People.
sentences.zh: 人。

sentences.en: Very hospitable.
sentences.zh: 非常热情好客。

sentences.en: Kind.
sentences.zh: 心地善良。

sentences.en: Caring.
sentences.zh: 充满关爱。

sentences.en: Full of love.
sentences.zh: 满怀爱心。

sentences.en: I've been a third of my life over there and two-thirds here.
sentences.zh: 我人生有三分之一的时间在那边，三分之二在这里。

sentences.en: Believe it or not, I remember the first one-third.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，我还记得最初的那三分之一。

sentences.en: To me here, time flies extremely faSt.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这里的时间过得极快。

sentences.en: Farhad came to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 法哈德来到美国

sentences.en: from Iran 47 years ago.
sentences.zh: 离开伊朗已经47年了。

sentences.en: Back then, he'd been trying to get a visa for years.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，他为了拿签证已经试了好几年。

sentences.en: For five years, I tried.
sentences.zh: 我试了整整五年。

sentences.en: Nothing happened.
sentences.zh: 没有任何进展。

sentences.en: But nothing seemed to work.
sentences.zh: 似乎怎么做都不行。

sentences.en: This was right before the Iranian Revolution.
sentences.zh: 这正好发生在伊朗伊斯兰革命之前。

sentences.en: A lot of other people were trying to get visas around the same time.
sentences.zh: 当时也有很多人在办签证。

sentences.en: One day, he showed up at the embassy.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他出现在了大使馆。

sentences.en: The whole street completely filled with people.
sentences.zh: 整条街挤满了人。

sentences.en: There were thousands of people there.
sentences.zh: 那里有成千上万的人。

sentences.en: Chances seemed slim he was going to be able to get his paperwork.
sentences.zh: 他能拿到文件的希望十分渺茫。

sentences.en: But then, he heard a man call his name.
sentences.zh: 但就在这时，他听到有人在叫他的名字。

sentences.en: And I was sort of surprised.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点吃惊。

sentences.en: No microphone, no speaker, nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有麦克风，没有扬声器，什么都没有。

sentences.en: He just yelled it, and I happened to be right there.
sentences.zh: 他只是大喊了一声，而我恰好就在那里。

sentences.en: I guess I'm kind of curious how that hits you and how you differentiate what you're doing when you cheer for Iran.
sentences.zh: 我想我挺好奇你是怎么看待这一点的，以及你在为伊朗加油时，是如何区分你所做的事情的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I could definitely see that it could be seen that way by some people.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全能理解在某些人看来确实会这样。

sentences.en: For me personally, it's more about the players and the Iranians as a people.
sentences.zh: 对我个人而言，这更多是关于球员和伊朗人民。

sentences.en: So that's kind of the perspective I'm going from.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我出发的角度。

sentences.en: You know, I'm going from a perspective of an Iranian-American specifically.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我特别从一个伊朗裔美国人的角度出发。

sentences.en: So I'm able to kind of separate it in my mind a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我能够在心里把它们稍微区分开来。

sentences.en: But if we didn't have the context of what's going on right now and it was just Iran is in the World Cup, I get to see Iran play in person,
sentences.zh: 但如果我们没有眼下这一切背景，只是单纯伊朗进了世界杯，我能亲眼看到伊朗踢球，

sentences.en: that would have me very excited already to begin with.
sentences.zh: 那我一开始就会感到非常兴奋了。

sentences.en: Because it's, you know, it's something that kind of taps into my heritage.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道，这在某种程度上触及了我的文化传承。

sentences.en: Like, these are some people who are like me and I don't get to relate to them every day because, you know, especially growing up, there weren't a lot of Iranians around.
sentences.zh: 就像，这些人就像我一样，而我没法每天都和他们产生共鸣，因为你知道，尤其是在成长过程中，周围并没有很多伊朗人。

sentences.en: But now this is a completely different situation because of the war and everything going on.
sentences.zh: 但现在情况完全不同了，因为战争和正在发生的一切。

sentences.en: There's kind of like this feeling like you're standing over a ledge or something.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像是你正站在悬崖边缘一样。

sentences.en: It's like there's this huge thing that's happening, but there's a kind of element of unease and danger and you don't really know how things are going to be resolved.
sentences.zh: 就像正发生着一件天大的事，但其中又有一种不安和危险的元素，你真的不知道事情会如何解决。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It feels like you both have such a lovely relationship just to each other, but also to this game and to soccer.
sentences.zh: 感觉你们俩彼此之间有着非常可爱的关系，同时对这项运动和足球也是如此。

sentences.en: And then there's this bigger geopolitical context, this war that's kind of like hanging all above it.
sentences.zh: 然后还有这种更大的地缘政治背景，这场战争就像是悬在这一切的上空。

sentences.en: More spicier.
sentences.zh: 更有戏剧性了。

sentences.en: It's spicier.
sentences.zh: 更刺激了。

sentences.en: It just makes everything a little bit spicier.
sentences.zh: 这让一切都变得更火爆了一点。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Is that how you're feeling?
sentences.zh: 你是这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: I feel like it turns up the heat is what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你的意思是这让局势升温了。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: I guess, how does it feel to sit in that spice, I guess?
sentences.zh: 我想问，身处这种刺激之中是什么感觉？

sentences.en: As I said, it's more challenging.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这更具挑战性。

sentences.en: We'll pass through it, hopefully.
sentences.zh: 希望我们能挺过去。

sentences.en: Sometimes, you know, you look at the curve in math, you know, always goes down before it can, has to meet a minimum point before it starts going up.
sentences.zh: 有时，你看数学里的曲线，它在开始上升之前，总是在下降，必须先触及一个最低点。

sentences.en: So you're saying there has to be a low point before there becomes a higher point.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，在迎来高点之前，必须先经历一个低谷。

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此，正是如此。

sentences.en: So what point of the curve are we at right now?
sentences.zh: 那么我们现在正处在曲线的哪一个点上呢？

sentences.en: I think, and I'm hoping, this is as the lowest it can go, not further than that.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我也希望，这就是能跌到的最低点，不会再往下走了。

sentences.en: And as far as whether this game now versus politics was not involved, it is more challenging, more spicier or whatever you want to call it.
sentences.zh: 至于这场比赛现在是否没有政治介入，它确实更具挑战性、更刺激，或者无论你怎么称呼它。

sentences.en: But hopefully it will pass through all these things.
sentences.zh: 但希望我们能挺过所有这些事情。

sentences.en: Kevin and Farhad left for the first Iran game with five hours to spare.
sentences.zh: 凯文和法哈德提前五个小时出发去观看伊朗的第一场比赛。

sentences.en: They were worried about traffic and parking, and they didn't want to miss a second of the game.
sentences.zh: 他们担心交通和停车问题，不想错过比赛的一分一秒。

sentences.en: Farhad's a planner, after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，法哈德是个喜欢未雨绸缪的人。

sentences.en: They had nice seats near one of the corners of the field, where, before the game started, a huge Iranian flag was unfurled.
sentences.zh: 他们的座位很好，靠近球场的一个角，比赛开始前，一面巨大的伊朗国旗在那里徐徐展开。

sentences.en: Please rise in favor for the national anthem of the Islamic Republic of Idah.
sentences.zh: 请起立，向伊达共和国国歌致敬。

sentences.en: And the country's national anthem played.
sentences.zh: 随后奏响了该国的国歌。

sentences.en: There were boos all throughout the stadium.
sentences.zh: 整个体育场内到处都是嘘声。

sentences.en: Some people turned around, so their backs faced the flag while the anthem played.
sentences.zh: 一些人转过身去，在国歌奏响时背对着国旗。

sentences.en: Others waved pre-revolution flags in proteSt.
sentences.zh: 还有人挥舞着革命前的旗帜以示抗议。

sentences.en: Farhad and Kevin just stood there, taking it all in.
sentences.zh: 法哈德和凯文就站在那里，默默吸收着这一切。

sentences.en: You know, so much of what we talked about earlier today was, you know, like, feeling torn.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们今天早些时候讨论的很多内容都是关于这种内心挣扎的感觉。

sentences.en: Have any of those feelings come up for you now that you're sitting here?
sentences.zh: 当你现在坐在这里时，有没有涌现出那种感觉？

sentences.en: There's a little bit just of the way the crowd is going and the way that they were booing, like, the anthem.
sentences.zh: 有一点点，就因为人群的反应以及他们发出嘘声的方式，比如对国歌发出嘘声。

sentences.en: But then when the players come in and play, they were cheering the players.
sentences.zh: 但当球员们入场比赛时，他们又在为球员欢呼。

sentences.en: So there's a little bit of that.
sentences.zh: 所以确实有那么一点这种感觉。

sentences.en: Are you saying that you resonate with both the boos and the cheers?
sentences.zh: 你是说你既对嘘声产生共鸣，也对欢呼声产生共鸣吗？

sentences.en: Is that what you're saying?
sentences.zh: 你是这个意思吗？

sentences.en: I mean, a little bit, because I understand what everything's representing, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一点，因为我理解这一切所代表的意义，你知道的。

sentences.en: Because I think for a lot of people, especially who are here right now in this stadium, it's the people who Iran means something different to them.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为对于很多人来说，尤其是此时此刻在这个体育场里的这些人，伊朗对他们而言有着不同的意义。

sentences.en: Because Iran means their childhood and where they grew up before the revolution.
sentences.zh: 因为伊朗意味着他们的童年，以及他们在革命前成长的地方。

sentences.en: So I think a lot of people are looking at it from that perspective.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为很多人是从那个角度来看待这件事的。

sentences.en: So they're cheering for Iranians and for the Iranian players and all that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在为伊朗人、伊朗球员以及所有这些欢呼。

sentences.en: But when the anthem comes on, then that represents a different part of Iran, you know.
sentences.zh: 但当国歌响起时，那就代表了伊朗的另一个部分，你知道的。

sentences.en: So it's like you're kind of watching people, like, draw lines in the sand in real time.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好像你在看着人们实时划清界限一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Iran tied that game.
sentences.zh: 伊朗那场比赛打平了。

sentences.en: They actually tied all of their games in the World Cup.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们在世界杯上的所有比赛都打平了。

sentences.en: And over the weekend, they were officially eliminated from the tournament.
sentences.zh: 而在周末，他们正式被淘汰出局了。

sentences.en: I talked to Farhad and Kevin on Sunday, and I asked them how they were feeling.
sentences.zh: 我在周日和法哈德以及凯文聊了聊，我问他们感觉如何。

sentences.en: Kevin was excited.
sentences.zh: 凯文很兴奋。

sentences.en: His other team, the U.S., is doing well.
sentences.zh: 他的另一支球队美国队表现不错。

sentences.en: And he's eager to watch them play in the next round.
sentences.zh: 他渴望看他们在下一轮比赛中踢球。

sentences.en: Farhad was disappointed.
sentences.zh: 法哈德则感到失望。

sentences.en: He felt like politics and the repercussions of the real world had seeped into the game.
sentences.zh: 他觉得政治和现实世界的波及已经渗透到了比赛中。

sentences.en: And it all made it impossible for Iran to succeed.
sentences.zh: 这一切使得伊朗不可能取得成功。

sentences.en: Before the Iranian team left Los Angeles, they wrote this note on a whiteboard in the dressing room of the stadium.
sentences.zh: 在伊朗队离开洛杉矶之前，他们在体育场更衣室的一块白板上写下了这样一则留言。

sentences.en: It said,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: From the ancient Persia of thousands of years ago to the civilized Iran of today, the spirit of Iran remains alive and steadfaSt.
sentences.zh: 从数千年前的古代波斯到今日文明的伊朗，伊朗的精神依然充满生机且坚定不移。

sentences.en: We came to Los Angeles with pride, competed with honor, and leave with dignity.
sentences.zh: 我们带着骄傲来到洛杉矶，带着荣誉竞争，并带着尊严离开。

sentences.en: Thank you, Los Angeles, for your hospitality.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，洛杉矶，感谢你们的热情好客。

sentences.en: And thank you to every Iranian who gave their heart, voice, and soul for Iran throughout these 180 minutes.
sentences.zh: 也感谢在过去的这180分钟里，为伊朗倾注了真心、声音和灵魂的每一位伊朗人。

sentences.en: May peace, respect, and friendship prevail among all nations.
sentences.zh: 愿和平、尊重和友谊在所有国家之间盛行。

sentences.en: I read it to Farhad and asked what he thought.
sentences.zh: 我把这段话读给法哈德听，并问他有何感想。

sentences.en: He said, They wrote what I feel.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们写出了我的感受。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.zh: 据一名美国

sentences.en: and Iran have agreed to stop attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and allow ships to move freely through it, according to a U.S.
sentences.zh: 官员透露，美国和伊朗已同意停止在霍尔木兹海峡的袭击，并允许船只在其中自由通行。

sentences.en: official.
sentences.zh: 官员。

sentences.en: Iran had yet to confirm that agreement as of Sunday night.
sentences.zh: 截至周日晚间，伊朗尚未证实该协议。

sentences.en: Pausing the hostilities would bring calm after a series of attacks in recent days.
sentences.zh: 暂停敌对行动将在近期发生的一系列袭击后带来平静。

sentences.en: After accusing Iran of striking an oil tanker in the Strait on Saturday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在指责伊朗于周六袭击了海峡内的一艘油轮后，美军

sentences.en: military carried out attacks on Iranian air defense sites and other military infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 对伊朗的防空设施及其他军事基础设施实施了打击。

sentences.en: Iranian forces retaliated on Sunday, saying they'd targeted a U.S.
sentences.zh: 伊朗军队于周日进行报复，称他们用无人机和导弹袭击了美国

sentences.en: naval base in Bahrain and an air base in Kuwait with drones and missiles.
sentences.zh: 位于巴林的的海军基地和科威特的一个空军基地。

sentences.en: No casualties were reported.
sentences.zh: 目前没有人员伤亡的报告。

sentences.en: And, more than three days after two earthquakes devastated Venezuela, the death toll rose to more than 1,400 people, with thousands more injured,
sentences.zh: 而在两场地震摧毁委内瑞拉三天多后，死亡人数已上升至1400多人，另有数千人受伤，
